title: Stadick v. Northern Illinois
disposition_detail: Complaint found out of order because it was not timely filed; no merits reached and no other relief granted.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed Ed Stadick’s complaint against Northern Illinois Presbytery as untimely. The roll call recorded 19 concurrences, 0 dissents, 0 abstentions, and 5 absent. No merits ruling appears.
summary: The SJC found Ed Stadick’s complaint against Northern Illinois Presbytery out of order because it was not timely filed. It therefore reached no merits and granted no relief.
